sofa noun

also couch, love seat, two-seater

modern

Traupman 125
Traupman 123

torus tōmentō fartus

a stuffed couch

A descriptive phrase rather than a unique modern furniture taxonomy. The nouns are torus, torī m. and tōmentum, tōmentī n.

Other words

  • sponda, spondae f. — a couch, sofa

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Verg. A. 1.698; Hor. Epod. 3.22; Mart. 3.91.9 (Lewis & Short); Andresian p. 2

    Properly the frame of a bed or couch (our sponda for the bed frame); by extension the couch itself, in poetry.

  • stibadium, stibadiī n. — a semicircular couch

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Plin. Ep. 5.6.36 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 297

  • bisellium tōmentō fartum — a love seat, a two-seater sofa

    also used · modern · Traupman 342

    Classically a bisellium was a seat of honour wide enough for two, granted to municipal dignitaries (Varr. L.L. 5.128, Lewis & Short); Traupman stuffs it with a cushion.

Examples

  • lectulus tōmentō fartus

    a couchTraupman 297
